value.summary: The pull request bumps two vendored submodules and migrates their breaking changes: repointing the openhuman path dependency to the new crate location and dropping the collapsed `openhuman::` module prefix, and restructuring the hivemind episode loop from single-turn steps to bounded rounds with a single commit-once state transition. The description is thorough and accurate — every significant change in the diff is accounted for, including the pinboard round-bound fix and the three migrated test fixtures. The code changes are consistent with the described behaviour and introduce no defects visible from the diff.
